items.item_text: 01. This application will ONLY be used to fill TEMPORARY positions with SCCCD. Are you available for a temporary position at this time? Options: Yes | No

02. Experience Requirement: One year of full-time experience is equivalent to 12 months of employment at 40 hours per week. Qualifying part-time experience will be prorated based on its full-time equivalent. Experience must be directly related to the position. Education Requirement: Thirty (30) semester units or forty-five (45) quarter units in a directly related field are equivalent to one (1) year of experience or one (1) year of school. All education and experience used to meet minimum qualifications must be clearly documented in the application. Do you understand this condition? Options: Yes | No

03. (MQ) Please select the level of education you possess: Please attach a copy of your transcripts showing when degree was awarded or your application may be deemed incomplete. Options: Formal or informal education equivalent to completion of the twelfth grade OR no related degree. | Associate's degree or higher
04. (MQ) Please select the level of progressively responsible clerical support experience you possess: Options: Less than four (4) years of experience | Four (4) years or more of experience.
05. (MQ) Do you possess at least one (1) year of progressively responsible clerical support experience in an instructional support setting in a university or college? Options: Yes | No
